edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to tx.origin and used as the buyer in buy().
tx.origin is used as an authorization condition inside buy().
block.timestamp gates the sale start time in buy(), creating timestamp dependency.
start state variable is compared with block.timestamp in buy().
price state variable is read during buy() payment validation.
limitPerOrder state variable bounds the requested amount in buy().
buy() calls the supply() view helper to check availability.
nft.balanceOf is invoked inside supply().
id state variable is used as the balanceOf token id in supply().
price is multiplied by amount in price.mul(amount).
amount parameter feeds the multiplication used to validate msg.value.
amount is forwarded as the transferred quantity in the external safeTransferFrom call.
msg.sender is the recipient argument of the external safeTransferFrom call.
id is passed as the token id to safeTransferFrom in buy().
nft state variable is the target of the external safeTransferFrom call in buy().
buy() executes the external safeTransferFrom before paying out ETH.
buy() performs the ETH payout after the external NFT transfer.
hausAddress is the beneficiary of the balance transfer in buy().
controller state variable is the reference checked by the onlyController modifier.
msg.sender is validated against controller inside onlyController.
onlyController restricts access to setTokenAddress().
onlyController restricts access to setTokenId().
onlyController restricts access to pull().
setTokenAddress overwrites the nft state variable with a caller-supplied address.
setTokenId overwrites the id state variable with a caller-supplied value.
pull() executes an external safeTransferFrom to the controller.
nft is the target contract of the external call in pull().
controller is the recipient of the tokens in pull().
id is the token id passed to safeTransferFrom in pull().
safeTransferFrom on an ERC1155 receiver can invoke onERC1155Received on the caller during buy().
safeTransferFrom in pull() can invoke onERC1155Received on the receiver.
msg.sender is stored as the controller during construction.
constructor assigns the deployer address to controller.
_hausAddress constructor argument is assigned to hausAddress.
_priceWei constructor argument is assigned to price.
_tokenId constructor argument is assigned to id.
_startTime constructor argument is assigned to start and later gates buy().
